text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, wh-what was that just now...? 
Actually, wait, is my body feeling all 
warm...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Could this actually be the true nature 
of the Seven Wonders?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Nah, this isn't a manga. I must've still 
been half-asleep~.
